decision.risk_assessment: Market is in a downtrend but severely oversold on short-term momentum indicators near key support levels, presenting high bounce risk.
decision.reasoning: Both BTC and ETH exhibit bearish trend structure across EMAs, but Stochastic is severely oversold (< 10) and RSI is near oversold levels with price sitting near 24h lows and Bollinger lower bands. Entering short positions at oversold support carries bad risk-reward, while entering long positions conflicts with the preferred trend-following style. Confidence to take new trades is below 60, so remaining in cash is optimal.
